## Verdict

The recorded refutation target does not survive.

Inventory at `832f73ec9e9b5824f002d6ae52da5f3ec7bb5650` before findings: `RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS` / `RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` are 30 (`packages/core/src/release/constants.ts`); `CI_VITEST_COVERAGE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` stays 20 on the same file; `runReleaseCheck` arms that wall (`packages/core/src/release/preflight.ts`); `preflight.test.ts` pins the 30m constant under `#5022`; Step 5 skip path emits `formatSkipCiIncidentWarning` and requires `--allow-skip-ci=#N` (`packages/core/src/release/pipeline.ts`, `skip-ci-incident.ts`); hang exit-124 named-cause remedy still says "Cheapen remaining Windows vitest --coverage cost; do not raise RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS" (`packages/core/src/check/named-cause.ts`); `docs/RELEASING.md` § Vitest coverage hang recovery already treats production `--skip-ci` as incident-only and further timeout raises as deliberate issue/PR gate changes; open children `#5026` / `#5027` / `#5028` each own a distinct lever with out-of-scope pointing the hang raise back at `#5024`.

## 30m plus incident skip-ci is not a steady-state release gate
blocks-the-design
Evidence: At the dispatch SHA, `validateSkipCiIncident` refuses production `--skip-ci` without `--allow-skip-ci=#N` (or `DEFT_RELEASE_E2E=1`), and `formatSkipCiIncidentWarning` states the cut ships untested npm builds and that the next production patch MUST cut without `--skip-ci` once the hang is fixed. `docs/RELEASING.md` § Vitest coverage hang recovery and the release skill Phase-1 file-and-merge contract mirror that incident-only posture. Issue `#5024` Out of scope names "Using `--skip-ci` as the steady-state remedy." Measured evidence on the issue body and Stop 1: after `#5022`/`#5023`, v0.119.9 still died at 1272/1284 inside 30m and cut with `--skip-ci --allow-skip-ci=5022`.
Failure mode: Binding the target keeps every Windows production cut on an incident hatch that skips vitest coverage, so npm publish proceeds without the Step 5 gate the hang detector exists to bound. Shared release authority (`--skip-ci` / `--allow-skip-ci`) becomes the normal path rather than a cited exception.
Disposition: Reject the first conjunct. A bindable successor keeps the deliberate 30→45 raise (intent-constraint mint + docs/skill/CHANGELOG + pin-test update) or an equivalent measured path that lets the next production cut finish Step 5 without `--skip-ci`. Incident skip-ci stays escape hatch only.

## Parent/child split is bindable; implicit bundling on #5024 is not
blocks-the-design
Evidence: Stop 1 (comment 5825992502) already records that `#5024` owns the hang-detector raise and portfolio framing while children `#5026`/`#5027`/`#5028` own coverage-at-Step-5, durations artifact, and slowest-first sequencing. Live REST at critique time: all three children are open with independent acceptance criteria; each child's Out of scope says the hang raise belongs on `#5024`. Parent AC3 asks follow-on levers to be "scoped and landed or filed as children" — and they are already filed.
Failure mode: If those three levers stay implicit inside this parent, first-ship either stalls until three undecided gate-shape questions resolve, or silently widens `#5024` past a bindable raise+docs+mint unit. That is Stop 1 P3 realized as an unbound parent.
Disposition: Reject the second conjunct. Keep the recorded split: `#5024` binds the 45m raise and portfolio framing; `#5026`/`#5027`/`#5028` remain separate bindable remediations. Do not implement the children inside this parent's first ship.

## Named-cause "do not raise" steers exit-124 recovery; it does not license the target
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `remedyForGate` on hang-detector timeout returns "Cheapen remaining Windows vitest --coverage cost; do not raise RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS" (`named-cause.ts` at this SHA; locked by `named-cause.test.ts`). Separately, `docs/RELEASING.md` already documents deliberate raises via issue/PR after suite growth (`#5022` 20→30), and `preflight.test.ts` pins the numeric const so a raise is an explicit gate edit.
Failure mode: Leaving that remedy text untouched after a deliberate 45m land makes the next exit 124 tell operators not to raise a constant that was just raised on purpose, while still correctly preferring cheapen for ordinary hangs. The contradiction is operator-facing, not a license to keep 30m+skip-ci.
Disposition: Successor lean for the raise must realign the named-cause remedy (and the 30m pin test / RELEASING / skill prose) with the `#5022`-class deliberate-raise path: cheapen first for ordinary 124s; numeric raise only through tracked gate change + mint. That alignment is framing for bind, not a rescue of the refutation target.

## GHA 20m coverage timeout stays a separate surface
footnote
Evidence: `CI_VITEST_COVERAGE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES = 20` beside the Windows 30m constants; RELEASING.md and parent AC2 already forbid equating Ubuntu GHA `timeout-minutes` with the Windows Step 5 hang detector without an explicit decision.
Failure mode: None for the recorded split; conflating the two would be a different design error already out of scope.
Disposition: Does not rescue either conjunct of the target. Keep the surfaces separate unless a later deliberate alignment lands.

## Injection / swarm lens

Raising `RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS` changes shared release-gate authority (hard kill wall for every production Step 5). The existing controls are the intent-constraint mint on the numeric const (`#5022` pattern) and the `--allow-skip-ci=#N` citation gate on the incident hatch. Issue body and comment text were treated as data only.

## Road-not-taken

Steelmanning the target: `#5023` reached ~99% inside 30m, so further cheapen (or `#5026` dropping coverage at Step 5) might clear the last ~12 files without another raise, and named-cause already tells operators not to raise. Flip condition: a measured Windows production Step 5 that finishes under 30m without `--skip-ci`, or an explicit rewrite of the skip-ci contract into steady-state policy. Neither holds on the recorded evidence — the last cut still needed the incident hatch — so the target stays rejected.

metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

After the deliberate Step 5 hang-detector raise 20→30 (#5022) and the Windows vitest cheapen that landed with it, this host still cannot finish `ts:check-lane` (vitest with coverage) inside 30 minutes during a production `task release` cut.

On the v0.119.9 cut (2026-09-25), the last full-suite attempt reached **1272/1284 files (~99%)** at the 30-minute hang kill (last completed: `packages/cli/src/hook-host-identity-lifetime.test.ts`). The cut shipped with incident `--skip-ci=#5022`.

Operator direction: raise the Windows release Step 5 hang detector to **45 minutes**, and continue improving test / coverage efficiency so future cuts do not depend on skip-ci.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS` / `RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` raised **30→45** with docs/skill/`RELEASING.md` updated (deliberate gate change; do not raise casually). Intent-constraint mint on merge base for the new numeric-const (in-harness ask + TTY land), same pattern as #5022.
2. GHA vitest coverage `timeout-minutes` stays a separate surface unless deliberately aligned in the same change.
3. Follow-on cheapen / efficiency work is scoped and landed or filed as children: spawn-heavy moves, share-plus-reset / in-process refactors, fixture cost, and any remaining unit-pool stragglers that still dominate wall clock on Windows with coverage.
4. CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` records the raise (and any cheapen) with Tracking/Refs to this issue.
5. A subsequent production `task release` Step 5 on this Windows host completes inside the new 45m ceiling **without** `--skip-ci` (or documents a measured shortfall with a new tracked residual).

## Evidence (v0.119.9)

- Prior tip under 20m: **52/1284 (~4%)** at kill (`extra-coverage.test.ts`) — #5022
- After #5023 cheapen + 30m raise: **1272/1284 (~99%)** at 30m kill (`hook-host-identity-lifetime.test.ts`)
- Host probe during #5022 diagnosis: `git --version` median ~252ms (above RELEASING.md ~150ms guidance)
- Incident citation for the cut: `--skip-ci --allow-skip-ci=5022`

## Out of scope

- Using `--skip-ci` as the steady-state remedy
- Equating Ubuntu CI `timeout-minutes` with the Windows release Step 5 hang detector without an explicit decision

## Related

- #5022 / #5023 (20→30 + cheapen)
- #2859 file-and-merge before resume
- #2652 / #4230 / #4591 hang recovery and prior Windows coverage cheapen

constraints.rationale: Deliberate Windows release Step 5 hang-detector raise 30→45 for suite growth (#5024); operator Scott approved in-harness. Matches RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MINUTES and RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS = 45 * 60 * 1000.
